subject.title: Ollama local provider: native tool_calls not recognized, falls back to unreliable JSON-text parsing

question: Should this issue wait for a live Ollama/MCP payload reproduction before any fix PR, or be closed as unsupported `/v1` configuration once config is confirmed?
rationale: Current source and release docs already support native Ollama tool calls, but the report is recent and concrete enough that closing without a payload-level config check could miss a real provider-normalization bug.

options.title: Request live payload proof
options.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or reporter captures the active provider config plus raw `/api/chat` or `/v1/chat/completions` request/response for the failing MCP tool call.

options.title: Close as unsupported config
options.body: Close only if the active provider is confirmed to be `api: "openai-completions"` or another `/v1` compatibility path where the docs already say tool calling is unreliable.

options.title: Queue a native-stream fix
options.body: Queue code work only if the captured native `/api/chat` response contains `message.tool_calls` that current OpenClaw fails to convert into structured `toolCall` content.

recommendation.title: Request live payload proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a maintainer or reporter captures the active provider config plus raw `/api/chat` or `/v1/chat/completions` request/response for the failing MCP tool call.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Ollama provider/docs ownership makes this the best routing candidate for deciding whether the remaining proof is sufficient.
